project.name: Kitbash Mecha
project.subtitle: v0.1: a first cinematic combat sandbox — assemble two weapon loadouts, press Fight, and watch deterministic anime / UC-legible 3D combat through the hybrid director. Fireworks first; the balanced gauntlet comes after.

nodes.title: Stack: Godot 4.6 + GDScript
nodes.goal: Steam-first, mobile-compatible; GDScript build, C++/GDExtension the only sanctioned perf escape hatch. Confirmed in practice by the director spike.

nodes.title: Deterministic sim + frozen log contract
nodes.goal: Same build(s) + seed produce the identical event sequence; simulation kept architecturally separate from rendering. This is the async-PvP re-simulation enabler.

nodes.title: Fireworks first, balance later
nodes.goal: The first playable is a cinematic combat sandbox, NOT a balanced gauntlet. Build weapon combinations for two mechs, press Fight, and watch deterministic anime combat through the hybrid director. Target: Gundam fight readability — different archetypes and match shapes must render differently (stomp, pitched duel, ranged pressure, melee chase, artillery finish, shield attrition), not a generic effects reel. Balance, shop economy, hearts, run structure, and long-run gauntlet progression are explicitly deferred until the sandbox proves the fights slap.

nodes.title: Fight event-log contract
nodes.goal: The frozen truth contract the viewer films (fight_log.gd schema + the design). The seam between sim and presentation; the viewer never writes it back.

nodes.title: Cinematic director + viewer grammar
nodes.goal: The locked viewer: hybrid director (iso tactical backbone + cinematic intercuts), shot grammar, grade (lighting/colour mood), sightline + X-ray occlusion, time-emphasis arbiter, garnish VFX / hero-kill spectacle.
nodes.doneWhen: A hand-authored fight log renders as a directed, UC-legible cinematic fight; golden-hash regression guards the hybrid shot list.

nodes.title: FeelProfile (per-build lean) — pure core
nodes.goal: Pure derive(build) -> {heft, tempo, mode_mix}: a per-build cosmetic bias, deterministic, never combat truth, never read by the sim.
nodes.doneWhen: feel_profile.gd + tests committed (determinism, monotonicity, bounds, empty/zero-damage fallback, outcome-independence).

nodes.title: Combat choreographer (log -> staged scene)
nodes.goal: Stage the positionless truth log into spawn positions + advance beats so the director has a 3D scene to film. Replaces hand-authored positions. Implementation exists uncommitted with a known same-tick precedence bug (Ada): when a reactive evade/stagger starts on the same tick as an ambient stride, both `advance` events are emitted and `_eval_layered()` / `_active_advance()` (and director event order) can pick ambient instead of the higher-priority reactive beat. Current 39 PASS misses it because the tests avoid stride-boundary reactive windows.
nodes.doneWhen: A contract-valid log is staged into deterministic positions the director films, AND the same-tick precedence bug is fixed (reactive evade/stagger on a stride boundary wins over ambient in both event emission and active-beat lookup), with a regression test that exercises a stride-boundary reactive window.
nodes.next: FIRST on the immediate route. Fix the same-tick precedence bug + add the stride-boundary regression test, then land. Design pass is complete.

nodes.title: Combat choreography grammar (theory-grounded staging)
nodes.goal: Replace the ambient choreographer's fixed pattern with a four-layer grammar (prosody/primitives/exchanges/dramaturgy) grounded in cited film theory (research synthesis C0-C40). Laws: CG-CONTRAST (per-mode), CG-SUSPENSE (no-pre-spoil gate + exciting-shape; suspense availability flagged as sim/balance), CG-BLIND (outcome-blind + causal/prefix-blind, incl. per-hit will-it-land micro-suspense). Data-extensible (motif/tier/travel + per-weapon mode-weights; archetypes = FeelProfile/preset data). The scheduler's total preemption rule subsumes cf-choreographer's same-tick precedence bug.
nodes.doneWhen: Beam-trade path staged TDD against the reference-diff + edge-fight fixtures: CG-CONTRAST, CG-NO-PRESPOIL, CG-BLIND (mirror + prefix-blindness), determinism, and range/measure gates pass; the recreated reference fight tracks the hand-authored reference's metric band. Other modes are registered stubs.
nodes.next: Approved design (rev 7; codex IMPLEMENTATION-READY, design-level blockers none). Implement the lean file set (choreographer.gd + grammar_params + movement_trace) beam-trade-first.

nodes.title: Fireworks profiler + parity report
nodes.goal: The spectacle-profile tooling: read a fight log (authored or generated) and emit its spectacle profile — intended archetype/matchup shape, duration, event/attack density, longest dead-air gap, weapon mix, heavy-beat count, defensive/reversal beats, movement/boost/stagger profile, director-beat availability, finisher quality, taste verdict. Tracking records the intended archetype + spectacle shape, not only raw event counts. Plus a comparison report of any candidate log against fight_log_everything.json as the fireworks floor (not as a metronomic mold to mimic).
nodes.doneWhen: A profiler produces a spectacle profile for fight_log_everything.json (baseline: 23.1s, 101 events, 50 attacks, 48 advances, 10 boosts, full arsenal, lethal buster finish) and a comparison report runs candidate-vs-baseline with a dead-air / spectacle-floor check.
nodes.next: Second on the immediate route. Build the profiler over the existing fight_log schema, then the comparison report.

nodes.title: M0 — Minimal weapon-combination sim (build-vs-build)
nodes.goal: The smallest deterministic build-vs-build sim: two weapon combinations + a seed -> a contract-valid combat-truth event-log, then wired sim -> choreographer -> hybrid director (a temporary v2->v1 adapter is allowed if it is the shortest path). No grid economy required yet — it consumes a raw loadout so the sandbox can run before the full M1 editor. Different archetypes (rifle/missile pressure, buster artillery, saber/booster aggression, shield/tank attrition, mixed arsenal) must produce distinct logs and distinct camera/staging reads. Later extended to consume the M1 grid build.
nodes.doneWhen: Two weapon loadouts + seed resolve to a contract-valid log that the choreographer stages and the hybrid director films; same loadouts + seed reproduce the identical normalized log byte-for-byte; no dead-air failure vs the fireworks floor.
nodes.next: Third on the immediate route. Built after the choreographer lands and the profiler exists.

nodes.title: Crude build picker + fight launcher
nodes.goal: A crude UI to choose/assemble two weapon loadouts and press Fight, launching the deterministic sim -> choreographer -> director pipeline. Minimal — not the full M1 grid editor; just enough to drive the sandbox and pick distinct archetypes.
nodes.doneWhen: A player can pick two loadouts, press Fight, and watch the generated cinematic fight; re-running the same picks + seed replays the identical fight.
nodes.next: Fourth on the immediate route. Built after the minimal sim is wired to the director.

nodes.title: First Cinematic Combat Sandbox (first playable)
nodes.goal: The v0.1 first-playable finish line: assemble/choose weapon combinations for two mechs, press Fight, and watch deterministic anime / UC-legible combat through the hybrid director. Archetypes and match shapes render differently — stomp, pitched duel, ranged pressure, melee chase, artillery finish, shield attrition.
nodes.doneWhen: At least three build archetypes (e.g. rifle+missiles, buster+shield, saber+booster) produce deterministic, visibly different spectacle profiles AND rendered reads; each has a comparison report vs fight_log_everything.json; each offers director-usable beats (opening hero beat, mid escalation, heavy/finisher, aftermath) with no dead-air failure.
nodes.next: Gauntlet/shop/hearts come AFTER this proves the fights slap.

nodes.title: FeelProfile consumers (grammar + choreographer bias)
nodes.goal: The director grammar and choreographer read each build's FeelProfile and bias their own params, so a loadout visibly looks like itself on screen — a gun-heavy build films different from a melee-heavy or rapid-fire one. Sharpens the sandbox's archetype reads but is not a hard gate on the first playable.
nodes.doneWhen: Two different weapon loadouts on the same frame read distinctly on screen; the FeelProfile leaf is no longer dead.
nodes.next: Parallel polish — build after the choreographer lands.

nodes.title: M1 — Grid + power build editor (richer build path)
nodes.goal: The richer build editor on ONE mech frame: a 5x4 unified grid; place shaped builder/spender/support items in varied weapon loadouts and quantities; a single power battery economy; supports buff adjacent weapons (added/increased/more) AND author adjacency transforms (fork/chain/multishot) in their slots; slotted weapons mount on the shared 3D mech. Parallel to the sandbox's crude build-picker — this is the deeper build surface the later gauntlet needs, not a gate on the first playable.
nodes.doneWhen: Place a varied loadout (different weapons + quantities); see effective damage, power-per-shot, and authored transforms (fork/chain/multishot) change as supports cover a weapon; read total pool+regen; see weapons mount on the 3D mech. Resolver + grid pure and unit-tested.
nodes.next: Standalone-testable; can proceed in parallel with the sandbox route. Build-screen UI design (in Claude design) -> implementation plan -> build.

nodes.title: M3 — The gauntlet run (deferred behind the sandbox)
nodes.goal: Deferred until the cinematic sandbox proves the fights slap. The balanced run: a shop phase (buy/sell/reroll) then a deterministic cinematic auto-battle vs a ghost opponent; a few hearts, a loss costs one, ends at zero or a win threshold; no persistence; pilot as the item-source hero. One frame; variety comes from weapon loadout + placement.
nodes.doneWhen: A tester plays a full escalating run building varied weapon loadouts that each keep functioning AND stay cinematic; the placement decisions feel like the fun.
nodes.next: Starts only after cf-sandbox is shipped.

nodes.title: M2 — Scaling vectors, recipes, expansions (deferred)
nodes.goal: Deferred out of v0.1: distinct tall/wide/tank scaling vectors and archetype viability, bag-expansion container items, recipe/merge fusion at the round transition. v0.1 stays one frame; these add the multi-frame/archetype depth.
nodes.doneWhen: Tall, wide, and tank builds are each viable; expansions + recipes work end to end.

nodes.title: v0.2+ — Pilot-fit / sync layer
nodes.goal: The pilot bond on top of the engineering core: the in-fight sync / breakthrough meter (re-entering as item behaviour), a persistent bonded pilot, salvage acquisition, and grid expansion through pilot milestones.

nodes.title: Async-PvP war (networked)
nodes.goal: The networked backend for real-player ghosts and async-PvP; the two-faction GM-steered live war. No dates; architecture must not preclude it.
